snippet.title: Mugen Souls Gameplay Trailer (PS3)
snippet.description:
Mugen Souls Gameplay Trailer (PS3). NISA confirmed localization of 3 PlayStation exclusives for North America and Europe. Legasista and Mugen Souls and The Witch and the Hundred Knights.
A a colorful free-roaming battler exclusive PS3 game, through PSN, coming Fall 2012.
